30-60-90 DAY PLAN

Earn trust.
Understand the business.
Then shape the team.

Listening, relationship building, and team assessment run in parallel. The goal is an informed direction and shared commitment before major structural changes.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS BEFORE RECOMMENDATIONS

Start with the people
closest to the work.

Meet broadly across the organization: leadership, regional teams, recruiters, agents, team leaders, and brokers. Learn how each market operates, where people see value, and what gets in their way.

  • Build relationships with established producers and key teams from the outset.
  • Understand the agent experience, recruiting motion, and retention drivers.
  • Review available data and reconnect with my network to develop a future talent bench.

Outcome: Trust, a grounded view of the business, and a clear set of questions to investigate.

UNDERSTAND WHAT TO PRESERVE AND DEVELOP

Assess the team.
Find the shared ground.

Continue listening while evaluating capability, results, coachability, and willingness to adapt. Identify strengths worth preserving, development needs, and gaps in the growth function.

  • Compare regional practices and identify what could work nationally.
  • Assess people through conversations, observed execution, and evidence.
  • Align leadership on recruiting quality, retention, reporting, and the agent value proposition.

Outcome: A balanced assessment of the team and agreement on the most important opportunities.

DESIGN A PATH PEOPLE CAN EXECUTE

Recommend the structure.
Prepare the transition.

Bring leadership an evidence-based recommendation for roles, management, regional coordination, and talent. Confirm what should change, what should stay, and how to sequence the work.

  • Evaluate the three-role national model against what I have learned.
  • Define responsibilities, progression milestones, and coaching expectations.
  • Prepare a phased implementation and talent plan, including the existing team and my network.

Outcome: An agreed direction and a practical roadmap for the next phase.
